headline: Claude Opus 5 is live. The useful question is whether it improves your work, not its launch chart.

qualifiedInterrupt.whyNow: Anthropic’s July 24 launch makes Opus 5 a currently available top-end Claude choice at the prior base API price, while its current documentation changes the practical migration advice.
qualifiedInterrupt.readerDecision: Claude users with demanding coding or knowledge work should run one controlled comparison before changing a default; readers without that job should wait rather than switch on provider claims alone.
